ILANG GRUPO SA EDSA SHRINE, NAGMARTSA NA

Nagsimula nang magmartsa ang ilang grupo sa kahabaan ng EDSA patungo sa EDSA Monument ngayong Sabado, Setyembre 13, bilang bahagi ng kanilang protesta laban sa korapsyon sa gobyerno.

Samantala, nitong Biyernes, Setyembre 12, nagsagawa din ng “Black Friday protest” ang ilang estudyante mula sa University of the Philippines (UP) Diliman.

COURTESY: Philippine Collegian/Facebook

NEWS UPDATE | The Department of Foreign Affairs (DFA) has confirmed that it has filed a diplomatic protest against China’s establishment of the "Huangyan Island National Nature Reserve" at Scarborough Shoal.

“The Department filed a protest yesterday, which is a strong,  unequivocal and formal articulation of PHL objections to the CHN action,” DFA Spokesperson Angelica Escalona said.

On Wednesday, September 10, the Chinese government announced its approval to establish a national nature reserve at the disputed Scarborough Shoal in the South China Sea to protect its ecosystem's “diversity, stability, and sustainability”. | via Katrina Manubay
